title: Canonical report digest without its self-digest
instruction: Write solution.py defining solve(value). The input is a JSON object. Return a lowercase SHA-256 hex string for the report using this exact Python serialization contract: remove ONLY the top-level key named report_sha256, if present; preserve every other key, value, nested key, and array order; serialize the remaining object with json.dumps(report, ensure_ascii=False, sort_keys=True, separators=(',', ':'), allow_nan=False); encode that string as UTF-8; compute SHA-256. Do not normalize Unicode, trim text, remove nested report_sha256 fields, or change the input object. Inputs contain only ordinary JSON values and finite numbers. Use only Python's standard library. This is a deterministic development exercise, not signature verification or a claim that the report contents are true.
